snippet.title: Jako pierwsza kobieta w historii uciekła z Auschwitz. Zapłaciło za to 200 innych
snippet.description:
Janina Nowak (ur. 19 sierpnia 1917 w Będowie), więźniarka KL Auschwitz nr 7615. 24 czerwca 1942 r. jako pierwsza kobieta uciekła z Auschwitz. W odwecie jej towarzyszki z komanda zostały ogolone i przeniesione do karnej kompanii w Budach. Ujęta w marcu 1943 r., przeżyła wojnę w KL Ravensbrück.

Źródła:
▪ Państwowe Muzeum Auschwitz-Birkenau, lekcja „Kobiety w KL Auschwitz: Ucieczki kobiet“ (lekcja.auschwitz.org)
▪ Muzeum Auschwitz, wpis z 24 czerwca 2024 r. na profilu @AuschwitzMuseum
▪ Faces of Auschwitz / Twarze Auschwitz, „Janina Nowak“ (facesofauschwitz.com)
▪ WielkaHistoria.pl, „Janina Nowak. Pierwsza kobieta, która uciekła z Auschwitz“
▪ Marta Byczkowska-Nowak, „Którędy na wolność? Historia pierwszej dziewczyny, która uciekła z Auschwitz“ (powieść oparta na faktach)

Uwagi:
▪ Drugi numer obozowy podawany jest jako 31529 (Muzeum Auschwitz) lub 31527 (Wikipedia).
▪ Moment wykrycia ucieczki źródła podają różnie: w porze obiadu lub na apelu po pracy.

Jedno zdanie warto mieć na oku: „Esesmani pilnowali dużej grupy na otwartym terenie“. To ogólny opis warunków pracy komanda, a nie konkretna relacja z tego dnia — źródła nie opisują, jak dokładnie się oddaliła.

snippet.title: How the X-15 Flew at Mach 6.7 and Came Home Burned #shorts #aviation #engineering
snippet.description:
In 1967, U.S. Air Force pilot William "Pete" Knight flew the North American X-15A-2 to Mach 6.7 (4,520 mph / 7,274 km/h)—a world record that remains the fastest speed ever achieved by a crewed, powered aircraft in aviation history.

Because the rocket plane carried liquid propellant for only about 2 minutes of burn time, it was air-launched from a NASA B-52 Stratofortress mothership at 45,000 feet. To survive hypersonic atmospheric friction exceeding 2,000°F (1,093°C), the airframe was sprayed with a special white MA-25S ablative heat shield coating.

At peak hypersonic velocity, extreme shockwave heating concentrated like a blowtorch against the lower ventral fin, burning through the titanium structure and tearing off a dummy scramjet test engine. Completely out of fuel, Knight glided the damaged aircraft back to Edwards Air Force Base, executing an unpowered deadstick landing on steel skids across Rogers Dry Lake at 200 mph.

snippet.description:
ചേരാനല്ലൂരിൽ കാറിടിച്ചു മരിച്ച ജയപാലകൃഷ്ണന്റെ തട്ടുകട വീണ്ടും തുറന്നു പ്രവർത്തിക്കാൻ തുടങ്ങി. കുടുംബാംഗങ്ങളായ ഭാര്യയും മകനും ചേർന്നാണ് കട തുറന്നത്. ജയപാലകൃഷ്ണന്റെ ചിത്രത്തിൽ തിരിതെളിയിച്ചാണ് ചിറ്റൂർ നിവാസികൾക്ക് ഏറെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട കടയുടെ പ്രവർത്തനം പുനരാരംഭിച്ചത്.

The roadside eatery run by Jayap Krishnan, who died after being hit by a car in Cheranalloor, has reopened. His wife and son jointly reopened the shop. The eatery, which was much loved by the residents of Chittoor, resumed operations with locals lighting a traditional lamp in front of Jayap Krishnan’s photograph.

snippet.title: PON Pertama di Papua: 73 Thn Menunggu 🇮🇩 | Seri 6 Jokowi Membangun Papua #shorts  #terimakasihjokowi
snippet.description:
🇮🇩 PON pertama di Tanah Papua: 73 tahun menunggu. Seri 6 Jokowi Membangun Papua.

📅 Sejak 1948 PON berpindah dari kota ke kota. Tahun 2014 Papua terpilih jadi tuan rumah PON XX.

📜 Jokowi menerbitkan instruksi presiden: seluruh kementerian wajib mendukung. 1 April 2019 ia datang sendiri meninjau stadion.

🏟️ Stadion utama Lukas Enembe dibangun Pemerintah Provinsi Papua. Pemerintah pusat membangun tujuh arena baru, sekitar Rp1,5 triliun dari APBN: akuatik, panahan, kriket, hoki, sepatu roda, dayung, dan Istora Papua Bangkit yang atapnya meniru honai, rumah adat suku Dani. Tiga rekor MURI.

😷 Pandemi datang, PON ditunda setahun, tapi tetap di Papua.

🔥 2 Oktober 2021, Pak Jokowi: "Kita bangga berada di stadion terbaik di Asia Pasifik ini. Kita bangga membuka PON ke-20, PON yang pertama kali diselenggarakan di Tanah Papua."

⚽ Seorang anak Papua mengajak Presiden turun ke lapangan, main bola bersama.

🥇 Di kandang sendiri Papua meraih emas ganda sepak bola, putri dan putra, dan finis peringkat 4, terbaik sepanjang sejarah Papua di PON.

🌱 2022 Jokowi meluncurkan Papua Football Academy di stadion yang sama, untuk mencetak Boaz Solossa berikutnya.

"Yakinlah, kemajuan Papua akan berjalan cepat." – Pak Jokowi

snippet.title: Why Infiltrators & Liberals Are SCARED of Amit Shah's Border Security Project? #shorts
snippet.description:
Why Infiltrators Are SCARED of Amit Shah's Border Security Project? #shorts 

Amit Shah has announced an ambitious Smart Border Project aimed at strengthening India’s international borders through advanced technology and surveillance.

The plan focuses on developing a high-tech security grid across nearly 6,000 kilometres of international borders, using drones, radar systems, high-resolution cameras and other advanced technologies to detect and prevent infiltration.

But border security is not just about surveillance and fencing. The government is also focusing on strengthening border communities through the Vibrant Villages Programme. Under its second phase, 1,954 villages near India's international land borders are set to receive development support, with an emphasis on infrastructure and livelihood opportunities.

Another important component is the proposed Chaturbhuj Security Grid, bringing together the BSF, Army, border residents and local administration to improve coordination and intelligence-sharing.

In this video, we break down Amit Shah’s Smart Border Project, India’s technology-driven border security strategy and the government's broader plan to strengthen communities living along the borders.
